summary: Tested admin dashboard and analytics features - all backend APIs pass (16/16), frontend flows working correctly. Admin login, dashboard, waitlist table, analytics, logout, and auth protection all working.

issues: Section engagement chart only renders when sections.length > 0 (conditional render). No section_view events exist yet in DB so chart is hidden - this is correct behavior but may confuse admins when chart is absent.

critical_code_review_comments: JWT_SECRET uses secrets.token_hex(32) as default fallback - this means tokens become invalid on every server restart since secret changes. Should be set as env var for production.
JWT secret regeneration on restart could cause all admin sessions to be invalidated on backend restart.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All admin features verified: login/logout, JWT auth protection on /admin, overview cards (7 signups, page views, sessions, conversion rate), waitlist table with search and email rows, export CSV button, analytics tab with conversion funnel and daily signups chart. Section views chart is conditionally rendered (only when section_view events exist in DB - currently empty). Landing page analytics tracking (AnalyticsTracker) not deeply tested - would need real browser session to trigger IntersectionObserver events.
